## Decisions

- **Extract pure event mapper into mapper.ts**: Allows fast Bun unit tests without requiring Deno npm: import specifier shims.
- **Filter out events carrying extendedProperties.private.p3md_event_id**: Prevents sync loops where events pushed by our app get re-imported as new Google events.
- **Map all-day event start dates to 00:00:00+07:00 (Asia/Jakarta)**: Aligns with the application standard timezone specification for agenda displays.
